users.title: Users
users.description: Create and edit accounts, manage roles and groups, and review storage usage.
users.displayNameHint: Optional, up to 64 characters. Leave blank to use the username.
users.displayNameInvalid: Display name must be at most 64 characters without control characters
users.selectionInvalid: Select a valid role and status
users.selfEditHint: Changing your own username, email, role, status, or group requires signing in again. A display-name-only change keeps you signed in.
users.signInAgain: Account updated. Please sign in again
users.resetPasswordConfirm: Set this new password for {name}? They will be signed out on every device.
users.resetPasswordHint: Hand the new password to the user afterwards; all of their sessions and API tokens stop working immediately.

groups.title: User groups
groups.description: Manage upload quotas, file limits, and available storage policies.
groups.name: Group name
groups.capacityHint: Total capacity per member. Set to 0 for unlimited.
groups.maxFilePlaceholder: File size limit (MB), 0 for the server default
groups.maxFileHint: Maximum size of each uploaded file, any size you like. 0 uses the server default (server.max_upload_mb, 20 MB unless changed).
groups.maxFileLargeWarning: Files over {limit} MB are held in memory in full while they upload, convert to WebP and have their EXIF read and scrubbed, so a few at once can take several times that much memory and crash the server if it runs out. Make sure the server has enough memory, and raise your reverse proxy's body size limit (e.g. Nginx client_max_body_size) to match.
groups.extensionsHint: Leave empty to allow all extensions. Custom extensions are supported.
groups.rateHint: Uploads allowed per minute, including guests. Set to 0 for unlimited.
groups.policiesHint: Policies this group can select when uploading.
groups.hasMembers: This group still has members and cannot be deleted
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete group “{name}”? This cannot be undone.

storages.title: Storage
storages.description: Manage local and S3-compatible storage, test connections, and configure public URLs.
storages.empty: No storage yet. Choose Add storage to get started.
storages.referenced: This storage is still used by an upload policy and cannot be deleted
storages.secretHint: S3 credentials are submitted only during creation and stored encrypted. They cannot be viewed later. Editing changes only the name and base URL.
storages.editSecretHint: S3 credentials cannot be viewed or displayed after creation. To replace credentials, delete and recreate this storage.
storages.createSecretHint: S3 credentials are encrypted and cannot be viewed after creation. The connection test checks write, copy, and delete access.
storages.pathPrefixHint: Optional. Objects are stored under this folder of the bucket (or root), for example ShellBlogImg. Base URL must point at that folder, so returned links are Base URL + image path. It cannot change once the storage holds images.
storages.deleteConfirm: Delete storage “{name}”? This cannot be undone. Storage used by a policy cannot be deleted.

policies.title: Upload policies
policies.description: Configure path templates, WebP transcoding, thumbnails, and EXIF privacy.
policies.empty: No upload policies yet. Choose Create policy to get started.
policies.name: Policy name
policies.scrubAllOption: all (remove GPS, serial number, author, and XMP)
policies.dimensionsHint: Set width or height to 0 for no limit.
policies.privacyHint: Privacy filtering affects cloud copies, removing GPS, serial number, author, and XMP without re-encoding. The local database keeps full EXIF.
policies.deleteConfirm: Users of this policy will no longer be able to upload with it. Delete “{name}”?
policies.responsiveVariantsHint: For still images, also store 400/800/1600px wide WebP files; never enlarged, animations unchanged. Fill in older images with the backfill below.

settings.title: System settings
settings.description: Site, sign-up and sign-in, guests, email, plugins and backups.
settings.retentionNonNegative: Trash retention days cannot be negative
settings.siteNameHint: Shown in the browser title and page header.
settings.registrationHint: Turning this off prevents new sign-ups. Existing users are unaffected.
settings.guestUploadHint: Allow signed-out users to upload from the public home page and the Lsky v1-compatible API, using the guest group’s capacity and rate limits.
settings.galleryHint: After saving, the gallery lists eligible public images from all users, including existing images. Closing it stops the listing; shared image URLs and album random links remain accessible.
settings.galleryPublicAlbumsOnlyHint: When on, the gallery only shows public images that are in a public album. Images outside albums or in private albums are hidden.
settings.robotsModeHint: Controls /robots.txt for this site's own domain, including images on local storage (/i/, /t/). Domains of external storage such as S3 or B2 are not covered. "Block everything" is the safest; "Home and gallery only" lets crawlers fetch the home page, gallery and local images while the console, login, API and random-image links stay blocked. Console pages also carry noindex.
settings.robotsCustomHint: Served as written, up to 8 KB; left empty it blocks everything. With the sitemap on, add your own line: Sitemap: https://your-domain/sitemap.xml.
settings.sitemapHint: When on, /sitemap.xml lists the newest 1,000 public gallery images so search engines can index them. Needs the public gallery on and crawling not set to "Block everything". Refreshes at most every 10 minutes and never includes EXIF or uploader details.
settings.apiHint: Controls the /api/v1 Lsky-compatible API. Turning it off disables v1 endpoints; native /api endpoints are unaffected.
settings.retentionHint: Days to keep deleted images. Set to 0 for immediate permanent deletion.
settings.guestGroupHint: Guest uploads use this group’s capacity, rate limits, and policies. 0 means not set.
settings.defaultGroupHint: New users join this group by default. 0 means not set.
settings.avatarProviderHint: Avatar source for all users; WeAvatar is the default and can be switched to Gravatar. Ordinary users cannot change it.

mail.fromNameHint: Leave empty to show only the address.
mail.noMasterKey: The server has no security.master_key, so only SMTP relays without a password can be used.
mail.testToPlaceholder: Leave empty to send to yourself
mail.testSent: Test email sent. Check your inbox.
mail.testNeedsSave: Save your changes before sending a test.

reasons.rejected: The server rejected the message. Check that the from address matches the account.

variants.title: Responsive variant backfill
variants.intro: Generates the 400/800/1600px WebP variants of existing images whose rule has responsive variants on, one image at a time. It can be paused and resumes where it stopped after a restart.
variants.restartConfirm: Check every image again from the first one and reset the counters? Images that already have variants are skipped.
variants.loadFailed: Could not load the backfill status

lskyImport.title: Lsky Pro migration
lskyImport.description: Upload the SQL export of a Lsky Pro database to import its accounts, tokens, albums and images into ImgNest.
lskyImport.uploadHint: Export the whole Lsky PostgreSQL database to a .sql file with pg_dump, DBX or Navicat. The file is parsed in server memory only and never written to disk; upload it again after a restart.
lskyImport.modeAdoptHint: The rule's storage is the S3 bucket Lsky used (versioning must be on; B2 always has it). Originals stay where they are, byte for byte, and old links keep working; ImgNest only adds WebP, thumbnails and responsive copies next to them.
lskyImport.modeCopyHint: Downloads each original from its old public link and stores it under the same path in the rule's storage (usually a new bucket), scrubbing GPS and similar metadata per the rule. The old storage is left as it is.
lskyImport.adoptWarning: Adopted images are managed by ImgNest: deleting one in ImgNest makes its old link return 404 at once (the original stays in the bucket as an older version), and when the recycle bin expires or the image is purged the original is deleted too. Originals are never re-encoded, so their GPS and similar metadata stay in the bucket files, although ImgNest's public APIs never return it.
lskyImport.policyHint: Every imported group is bound to this rule.
lskyImport.strategyHint: When adopting, pick only the strategy stored in this bucket.
lskyImport.sourceUrlHint: Leave empty to use each Lsky strategy's URL.
lskyImport.startConfirm: Start the import? You can stop at any time; starting again skips what is already imported.
lskyImport.progress: Processed {processed} / {total}: imported {imported}, already imported {existing}, skipped {skipped}, failed {failed}
lskyImport.retryHint: Fix the cause and press Start import again; only the images that did not succeed are retried.
lskyImport.noPolicies: There is no rule yet; create one under Rules first.
lskyImport.loadFailed: Could not read the migration status

backups.title: Backup & export
backups.description: Pack the database and deployment configuration into a zip in the server's backup directory and download it.
backups.secretWarning: Backups contain password hashes, the database DSN and the master key. Only download them to a place you trust.
backups.name: File
backups.deleteConfirm: Delete backup {name}? This cannot be undone.
backups.keepHint: Only extra scheduled backups are removed; manual backups are never deleted.
backups.restoreHint: Stop the server, then run imgnest backup restore --yes <archive path> on it. The database must be migrated by the same release; files under the archive's config/ are not applied automatically, copy them back by hand if needed.
backups.imagesExcluded: Backup archives contain only the database and configuration, not image files. Back up local storage directories or object storage buckets separately. Restoring an archive cannot recover missing image files.

overview.title: Site overview
overview.description: Accounts, images and storage across the site. Sizes are charged cloud bytes (original, WebP, cloud thumbnail and responsive variants); the local thumbnail cache is not counted.

hints.variantsNone: No rule has responsive variants on

overview.uploadsNote: Counted by upload time (UTC), including images now in the recycle bin; imported Lsky images keep their original dates.
